That night the beam swept its tireless circle, and for the first time in years, he imagined leaving with it, following the light out across the dark water.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市陷入最深的静谧。路灯将橙黄的光洒在空旷的柏油路上，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水，声音被夜色吞没。早点铺的灯已经亮了，老板娘揉着面团，蒸笼里白雾升腾。清洁工推着小车沿街而行，扫帚划过地面发出沙沙的低响。远处，写字楼顶层还亮着一盏灯，不知是加班的人还是忘了关。天边隐约泛出一线灰蓝，鸟还没醒，风还没起，整座城像一个浅眠的人，正在梦与醒之间轻轻呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function solves a problem by calling itself with a smaller version of the same problem — like looking up a word in the dictionary and finding the definition uses another word you also need to look up.\n• Every recursive function needs a \"base case\" — a simple situation where it already knows the answer and stops calling itself, so it doesn't keep going forever.\n• Imagine you're in a line of people and you want to know how many are behind you: you ask the person behind you, they ask the person behind them, and so on until the last person says \"zero\" — then the answers pass back up the line, each adding one."}
